meta.aciklama:
Music for your videos just became free. Unlimited music and sound effects, made on your own computer.

Audio Studio is a free, open source tool that plugs into Claude Code. You describe a sound in one sentence, and it generates the track or the effect locally, loops it and levels it for your edit. Nothing gets uploaded, and there is no monthly bill.

Comment "AUDIO" and I'll send you the setup guide.

transkript.t: Music for your videos just stopped costing you money.
A developer on GitHub released a free tool
that makes unlimited music and sound effects
on your own computer, low-fi beats, cinematic trailers,
rain, glass shattering, and anything you can describe.
and it plugs straight into cloud code.
The second your edit needs a sound, you describe it.
Seconds later, it's generated, looped, leveled,
Want the link? Comment, audio, and I'll send it to you.
